change_summary: Add only the two preregistered H1 relative-context features as additional context to an isolated shadow evaluator. No threshold, transform, score weight, model, pair subset, baseline rule, entry/exit/risk mechanic or active V2R3 behavior is changed.

evidence_plan.minimum_gate: >=24 elapsed hours AND >=200 matched prospective candidates AND >=95% H1 context capture success. If fewer than 5 baseline-vs-H1 decision divergences occur, classify INCONCLUSIVE_LOW_IMPACT and do not tune or auto-extend.
evidence_plan.cost_model_reference: Same conservative V2R3 reference: 0.60% taker per side; pilot cannot promote to live.

promotion_gate.rule: Pilot evidence can only proceed to human project review. Any later promotion requires prospective net value after costs, separate release gate, and explicit approval; this pilot alone cannot promote.
